headline: Congress named a New Jersey post office in Raritan after Marine Gunnery Sergeant John Basilone.
what_it_does: This law renames the U.S. Postal Service facility at 30 East Somerset Street in Raritan, New Jersey, as the "Gunnery Sergeant John Basilone Post Office." It honors John Basilone, a Marine who received the Medal of Honor for his service in World War II. The law changes only the official name of the building and does not change postal services or rules.
when_it_takes_effect: The law took effect when it was signed on March 23, 2018.
